behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.37.0 for the Cisco platforms' names: the built-in cisco_iosxe is cisco_ios, for IOS and IOS XE alike, and cisco_iosxr is cisco_xr, --pi and --pr short for them, and platform-resolution.default ships as cisco_ios; cisco_xe and cisco_iosxe are read as cisco_ios and cisco_iosxr as cisco_xr wherever a platform name is read (an inventory row, a source default, --platform, --select-platform, platform-resolution.default and platform-resolution.unknown-fallback, a [platform.NAME] table's name and driver, a map rule's or a credential row's platform); records, job folders, and output carry the built-in's name; a glob matches built-in names alone; [platform.cisco_ios] beside [platform.cisco_iosxe] or [platform.cisco_xe] refused config_platform_name_invalid (exit 2); every counter is 0.37.0's (configuration schema 6, registry 32, execution plan 15, daemon IPC 12, command record 4, job manifest and summary 5, plan report 4, credential package 2, scoreboard 5, audit 2); Go and the modules are 0.37.0's; the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.37.0 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.37.0 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)

configuration_migration.notes: the configuration schema is unchanged from v0.10.0; config.schema-version stays 6; registry 32, unchanged from v0.37.0
